notes.title: WINTERUPDATE New GameMode and much more! v1.12
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from the happy Snowman! ;-)[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27935104/fb72912a50c7df2c6a98580418082ae72ae84ea7.jpg[/img]

This update brings a new GameMode into the game, improving the menu and the menu-room again, changing environments, and much more!
You can also now swipe with the left controller through the dance floors and with the right hand through the environments.

[h1]NEW:[/h1]
[List]
   [*]Added a new GameMode!
   [*]Improved many environments!
   [*]Changed the GameMode-Menu completely, now you can see all your achievements!
   [*]Improved the Menu-Room drastically!
   [*]Added a sweet snowman!
   [*]Improved the beat detection module. Beats get interpolated now. Beat detection will change in the future versions completely.
   [*]Redesigned the saving system of the progress entirely. Saving all your achievements is now possible.
   [*]Swiping through the dance floors with the left controller and swiping through the environments with the right controller is now supported!
   [*]Fixed some issues.
[/List]

[list]
[*][b]2 new Environments[/b]

[*]Added some other things under the hood (two player bodies). Be keen for the next updates ;-)
[/list]


And as always, stay tuned for the next updates and don't forget to rate the game, it would really help!

Have a great day!!

notes.title: NEW GAME-MODE and Streamer Layout!
notes.content:
[h1]"Tint It"
Shoot, colorize and break the Spheres appearing around you to the beat of your music.
Be fast, be precise and move alot for the best Score![/h1]

[h1]NEW:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a completely new Game-Mode!
[*]Added new Streamer Layout. Now every information will be displayed in realtime on your monitor too! You can also deactivate this function ;-)
[*]Added a new Environment "void" just only the dance floor with the music visualisation.
[*]Game-Mode Free Yourself lets your controllers vibrate now if there are rods avaliable! More rods -> stronger vibration!
[/list]

[h1]CHANGED/FIXED:[/h1]
